_week: 2026-10-26 to 2026-11-01 (Week 44). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Sales rose 3.7% to $46,558 on 9.5% more units: Pop Cups 6-Packs grew 16% to $16,008 and the Gift Set grew 33% to $4,775.
The Variety 12-Pack Kit fell 33% to $5,882 as stock ran down (162 available, out-of-stock alert on Nov 1), and Flavor-Wrapped fell 17% to $6,536 with 0 units available on the sheet.
refunds: Refunds were $895 on 44 units (2.3% rate) vs $677 on 42 units last week; the rate is slightly lower, so nothing points to a product problem.
pacing_reco: November starts at $7,375 a day vs $8,022 on Nov 1 last year; restocking the 12-Pack and 4-Pack Kits before BF/CM is the biggest lever.
ads_context: Ad spend was flat at $5,184 (+2.2%) but ad sales fell 14% to $14,235, so ACoS rose from 30.5% to 36.4%.
TACoS held at 11.1% because organic sales carried the growth: ads drove 30.6% of sales.
Campaign rows add up to $5,122 of the $5,184 account spend; about $62 isn't split by campaign in Sellerise.
ads_strategy: Branded keywords: $2,190 spend (+20%) at 37.1% ACoS, 212 orders.
Category keywords: $1,759 at 55.1% ACoS for 125 orders; spend there fell 14%.
Auto targeting spent $260 for $265 in sales (98% ACoS).
bid_moves: Lower bids on Sponsored Brands “opopop popcorn” exact: $929 spent for $1,288 in sales (1.4x).
Cut or lower “opopop” exact (SB), “microwave popcorn” exact and “popcorn making kit” phrase: each returned about 1x.
Pause the 54 campaigns that spent $367 with no sales; keep “popcorn” exact (5.9x) and “popcorn opopop” broad (7.0x) funded.
coupons: This week: 35 coupon redemptions (38 last week).
Subscribe & Save orders rose to 183 from 151.
promotions: This week: 374 promotion orders and $808 in promotional discounts (vs 443 and $1,093 last week).
Lighter discounting while units still grew 9.5%.
events: Black Friday / Cyber Monday: Nov 27 – Nov 30.
Deal and coupon set-up deadlines: to confirm with the account team.
Priority: Pop Cup Kits and Flavor-Wrapped back in stock at FBA before Nov 20.
reviews_body: Sellerise returned no review records, rating trend or negative reviews for the 19 Opopop products over the last 90 days.
That means review tracking isn't pulling for this account, not that there were no reviews.
reviews_reco: Turn on review tracking for Opopop in Sellerise (or pull Amazon's Customer Reviews report) so the deck can show rating and review count per line.
Sellerise also shows 38 lost-Buy-Box alerts in 30 days, including Birthday Cake Pop Cups on Nov 1: worth checking alongside reviews.
recommendations: Send Pop Cups Variety 12-Pack and 4-Pack Kits now: about 1 week of stock left each.
Find out why Flavor-Wrapped shows 0 available with 1,891 on the sheet and get it live at FBA.
Restock Salty Caramel, Lightly Salted and Pickle Monster 6-Packs (1–2 weeks left) and Birthday Cake (out).
Lower bids on the SB “opopop popcorn” exact targets and the ~1x category targets listed above.
Pause the 54 no-sale campaigns ($367); add the 18 converting search terms as exact keywords.
Pull budget from 12-Pack Kit campaigns until it's back in stock; push the 6-Packs and Gift Set.
Lock BF/CM coupons and deals for kits, Gift Set and 6-Packs (Nov 27–30).
Review lost Buy Box and listing-price alerts (43 critical in 30 days).
position: Week 44 sales of $46,558 were up 3.7% with units up 9.5%; TACoS steady at 11.1%.
November's first day ran at $7,375, 8% below Nov 1 last year; stock on the kits decides BF/CM.
next_steps: Restock the Pop Cup Kits and Flavor-Wrapped.
Trim low-return branded and category bids.
data_ask: Inbound ETAs for the kits and 6-Packs.
